final: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS FLOAT)) as avg_quantity, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) as cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) as overall_avg_qty FROM invoice_stats) SELECT invoice_stats.invoice_number, invoice_stats.avg_quantity, invoice_stats.cost_ratio, invoice_stats.avg_quantity - overall_avg.overall_avg_qty as qty_above_avg FROM invoice_stats CROSS JOIN overall_avg WHERE invoice_stats.avg_quantity > overall_avg.overall_avg_qty ORDER BY CASE WHEN qty_above_avg IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, qty_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
